$comment: Entitlements: who may do what in a ClinuxFlow clinic. Read by src/lib/shared/permissions.js (server checks) and served to clinux-frontend's Operations → Access & roles. Change entitlements here, not in code. `enforced` per permission is honest: 'server' = a clinuxflow-api route checks it; 'workspace' = only the workspace's screens apply it today. Role vs entitlement: an account role grants a set of permissions; a staff member's PROFESSIONAL role (PractitionerRole.code, SNOMED CT) is not an entitlement, and their HPR role (extension hpr-role: Healthcare Professional / Facility Manager) is an entitlement source — see hprRoles.

permissions.label: Run Front Desk, Consultation and Checkout
Find, link or create a patient’s ABHA
Link or register an HPR ID
Edit the facility profile and clinic page
Issue join links and approve staff
See their own activity and ABDM calls
See the whole clinic’s activity and ABDM calls

hospital_admin.label: Hospital admin
hospital_admin.summary: Runs a facility: its profile, team and clinic page, and sees the whole clinic’s activity.

admin_and_health_professional.label: Admin & health professional
admin_and_health_professional.summary: Everything: runs the facility and practises there. The default for new accounts.

health_professional.label: Health professional
health_professional.summary: Practises: patients, consultations and their own HPR profile. Sees only their own activity.

hprRoles.$comment: What a staff member's HPR role (PractitionerRole extension hpr-role) should grant at this facility. Not enforced yet: it takes effect once a login account is linked to its staff member's PractitionerRole (today accounts carry only the account role above).
